item.title: Trenton residents demand transparency as data center construction begins
item.description: Preliminary plans show multiple generator yards, extensive utility infrastructure including water, fire, sanitary sewer and storm sewer lines and detailed elevations for proposed buildings.

item.title: Friday's Lakota West versus Princeton boys basketball showdown moves to Cintas Center
item.description: Friday's Lakota West versus Princeton boys basketball game showdown has moved to Xavier University's Cintas Center. The game is scheduled for 7 p.m. Friday.

item.title: 'I'm feeling more disappointment' | Rules governing Mason County data centers approved in packed meeting
item.description: The Mason Joint Planning Commission advanced rule recommendations on data centers Wednesday. A 2,000-acre facility proposed near Maysville dominated the conversation.
